name: Shaku Natsuki
source:
A 21-year-old nurse in the virginity department. She’s a kind-hearted young woman who treats patients with genuine care. Her smile is truly angelic.

Her ultra-mini bodycon nurse uniform constantly offers glimpses of her underwear, leaving the patients utterly spellbound.

As the assigned nurse for the hospitalized protagonist, she stays by his side 24 hours a day and even shares a bed with him at night.

With her supple fingers, she strokes his phimosis penis. In her personal life, she is also a loving older sister who cares deeply for her younger brother. She is the main heroine of this work.

[From [url=http://www.milkcrown.co.jp/hakudaku/dotei/dt_natuki.html]official site[/url]]
